title: The Holiness of God
definition: The holiness of God means that God is perfectly pure, morally flawless, and completely set apart from all sin and corruption.
summary: God is not like fallen humanity. He is pure, righteous, majestic, and worthy of reverent worship. His holiness exposes sin and calls His people to holy living.
christFocus: Jesus reveals God's holiness through His sinless life, perfect obedience, and saving work that cleanses sinners and brings them near to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is not like fallen humanity. He is pure, righteous, majestic, and worthy of reverent worship. His holiness exposes sin and calls His people to holy living.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
